repair_commit: D4-A5-R7 repair post-plan-freeze gate and continuation handoff

defect_repaired.pre_repair: verify_continuation_plan_freeze_gate compared R1 and R2 repair artifacts against R1_HEAD; R2 artifacts were introduced at R2_HEAD (after R1), so git_blob(R1_HEAD, R2 artifact) = None != real blob -> false drift that blocked the real-repository plan-freeze verification after successful Phase P.
defect_repaired.post_repair: The gate uses per-stage owning-commit baselines via historical_baseline_drift (R6 semantics): A5 artifacts -> A5_STOP_HEAD, R1 -> R1_HEAD, R2 -> R2_HEAD, R3 -> R3_HEAD, R5 -> R5_HEAD. Missing-at-owning-stage and changed-after-owning-stage fail closed; later-stage absence at an earlier stage is not drift.

post_plan_lineage.r7_post_plan_retrieval_implementation_fr: R7 commit identified only by Git (HEAD message exact, HEAD parent = plan-freeze); its stable SHA is persisted only at future Phase-R runtime

checks: raw plans at R7 == raw plans at plan freeze

verification.plan_freeze_to_r7_changed_file_audit: exactly the 7-file R7 repair contract (continuation manifest excluded)

no_self_referential_sha.rule: R7 SHA depends on the commit tree; the commit tree must not depend on the R7 SHA
no_self_referential_sha.identity_established_only_by_git: HEAD message + HEAD parent + HEAD SHA after commit exists
no_self_referential_sha.stable_r7_sha_consumed_at: future Phase-R runtime (persisted into the manifest before the first retrieval call)

sequence: current HEAD is already the committed R7
stable R7 SHA is now known
retrieval_implementation_freeze_head and plan_freeze_head written into the runtime manifest

execution_integrity_seals.audit_finding: R7 historical-gate refactoring removed the previous clean-worktree/index seal: commit-to-commit Git checks could pass while Phase R or the evaluator consumed dirty worktree files, because execute_phase_r reads the worktree raw plans and the evaluator reads the worktree raw results.
execution_integrity_seals.phase_r_preflight_seal: verify_phase_r_preflight now begins with assert_clean_worktree (worktree AND index) before any other authorization check
execution_integrity_seals.raw_freeze_gate_seal: verify_continuation_raw_freeze_gate now begins with assert_clean_worktree; verify_continuation_evaluator_preflight inherits the seal through its call chain
execution_integrity_seals.historical_plan_freeze_verifier_unchange: verify_continuation_plan_freeze_gate stays head-independent and does not require a clean worktree (it validates the immutable 12b5dc6 boundary from a later descendant HEAD)
execution_integrity_seals.r7_repair_allowlist: 7 files exactly; evaluation/d4_a5_continuation_execution_manifest.json removed from R7_ALLOWED_REPAIR_FILES so a manifest change in an R7 commit is rejected by the Phase-R preflight repair-diff seal
